text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "This agreement automatically renews for successive two-year terms unless written notice is given by either party not to renew at least 90 days prior to the end of the initial Services Term or any renewed Services Term.","citations": [{"chunk_id": "C2", "quote": "The Services Term of this Agreement shall be automatically renewed for successive two-year terms thereafter unless written notice is given by either party to the other, indicating that party's intention not to renew the Services Term of this Agreement, at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the initial Services Term or any renewed Services Term."}]}
